identity.name: Bambino Version IV
identity.one_liner: The affordable dress automatic that defined entry-level mechanical watchmaking for a generation of collectors across Asia and beyond.

narrative.story: The Bambino Version IV refines the 2012 original with a domed mineral crystal, a sunburst domed dial, and Orient's in-house F6724 caliber — hand-winding and hacking, both rare at this price point. The 40.5mm case and 21mm lug width give it a presence that reads above its cost. The Bambino has been Orient's most-cited dress watch since the first version launched, and the V4 is the most refined of the series.
narrative.collector_notes: The F6724 replaced the earlier 46943 in the Bambino line, adding hand-wind and hacking. Check domed crystal height — the V4 sits taller than the V1-V3.
